select aa.category_cd , aa.category_nm , aa.step_day_cd , aa.step_day_nm , aa.progress_type_cd , aa.progress_type_nm , aa.contents_info , aa.question , 1 as answer_choice_seq , string_agg(aa.answer_choice,' // ') as answer_choice from ( select cqi.category_cd , (select val from sys_code_det scd where scd.code = 'CATEGORY_CD' and scd.cd = cqi.category_cd) as category_nm , cqi.step_day_cd , (select val from sys_code_det scd where scd.code = 'STEP_DAY_CD' and scd.cd = cqi.step_day_cd) as step_day_nm , cqi.progress_type_cd , (select val from sys_code_det scd where scd.code = 'PROGRESS_TYPE_CD' and scd.cd = cqi.progress_type_cd) as progress_type_nm , cqi.contents_info , replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(cqi.question_orgl,'#NN','( )') ,'#SS','( )') ,'#DD','( )') ,'#NN','( )') ,'#HH','( )') ,'#MM','( )') ,'#UN',#{name}) ,'#BV','( )') ,'#BS','( )') as question , cuai.answer_choice_seq , cuai.answer_choice from coaching_question_info cqi left join (select * from coaching_user_answer_info where account_seq = #{acSeq}) cuai on cqi.category_cd = cuai.category_cd and cqi.step_day_cd = cuai.step_day_cd and cqi.progress_type_cd = cuai.progress_type_cd where 1=1 and cqi.category_cd = #{categoryCd} and cqi.hospital_seq = (select hospital_seq from cm_doctor where seq = #{dSeq}) ) aa group by aa.category_cd, aa.category_nm, aa.step_day_cd, aa.step_day_nm ,aa.progress_type_cd,aa.progress_type_nm,aa.contents_info,aa.question order by aa.category_cd, aa.step_day_cd, aa.progress_type_cd

select ac.seq , ac.name , ac.birth , ac.gender , ts.disease ->> 'name' as disease_name , ts.disease -> 'diseaseTreatment' -> 0 ->> 'name' as disease_Treatment , ts.disease , scd.cd as category_cd , scd.val as category_nm , (select count(*) from coaching_question_info cqi where cqi.progress_type_cd in ( 'A1','E01','K01') and cqi.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_question_step_day_cnt , (select count(distinct step_day_cd) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as tot_answer_step_day_cnt , (select max(created_at) from coaching_user_answer_info cuai where cuai.account_seq = ac.seq and cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) as created_at from account ac left join track_service ts on ac.seq = ts.account_seq and ts.status = 'ACTIVE' , sys_code_det scd , hospital_service hs where 1=1 and scd.code = 'CATEGORY_CD' and scd.use_yn = 'Y' and scd.cd in ('A','B','C','D') and ac.seq = hs.account_seq and hs.hospital_seq = (select hospital_seq from cm_doctor where seq = #{dSeq}) and ac.is_enabled

and ac.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
